facts.fact: Kenya's PPP Directorate said on 2026-10-23 it signed a funding agreement to prepare the Konza National Data Centre Cloud Expansion project at Konza Technopolis, which targets more capacity for cloud computing and emerging technologies including AI, with no private partner yet selected.
